resources.string: Android accepted the request.
Nothing to do.
Android does not track this interface for tethering (error 1).
Unplug the adapter, plug it in again, then start again.
A system service that tethering needs is not available (error 2).
Restart the phone, start Shizuku again, then try again.
Tethering is not supported or not allowed on this phone (error 3).
Check that no work profile, device policy or carrier setting blocks tethering, then try again.
The Ethernet interface is not available (error 4).
Check that the adapter is plugged in and recognised, then start again.
Android reported an internal tethering error (error 5).
Stop, unplug the adapter, plug it in again and start again. If it repeats, copy the log and report it.
Android could not set up the Ethernet interface (error 6).
Unplug the adapter, plug it in again and start again.
Android could not release the Ethernet interface (error 7).
Unplug the adapter; Android then ends Ethernet tethering by itself.
Android could not share the internet connection over Ethernet (error 8).
Choose local only, which shares no internet, and start again.
Android could not stop sharing the internet connection (error 9).
Unplug the adapter. If sharing continues, restart the phone.
Android could not set the IPv4 address on the interface (error 10).
Check the addresses. If they are right, unplug the adapter, plug it in again and start again.
The carrier tethering check failed (error 11).
Choose local only, or turn mobile data off while tethering, and start again.
Android\'s DHCP server could not start (error 12).
Use a prefix length from 16 to 30, for example /16, and start again.
The carrier tethering check gave no answer (error 13).
Choose local only, or turn mobile data off while tethering, and start again.
Android refused the request because a permission is missing (error 14).
Start Shizuku with wireless debugging, not with root, then try again.
Android refused to report the tethering state (error 15).
Start Shizuku with wireless debugging, not with root, then try again.
This phone does not support Ethernet tethering (error 16).
EtherTether cannot change this. Copy the log and report the phone model.
There was no tethering request to stop (error 17).
Nothing to do.
Ethernet tethering is already starting or running (error 18).
Stop first, then start again.
Android returned error %1$d, which this version does not know.
Copy the log and report it, with the phone model and Android version.
Ethernet tethering is on, sharing the internet connection, on %1$s.
Ethernet tethering is on, local only, on %1$s.
Addresses: %1$s
Connect the device on the other end of the cable.
Android accepted the request, but no Ethernet adapter serves yet.
Plug in the adapter. Android serves it as soon as it appears. If it is plugged in, stop and start again.
Ethernet tethering is off.
Android started tethering, but the interface %1$s failed.
Android did not answer in time.
Try again. If it repeats, stop and start Shizuku again.
This Android version lacks a part EtherTether needs: %1$s
Open the debug screen, run Diagnose, copy the log and report it with the phone model and Android version.
The connection to Shizuku was lost.
Open Shizuku, start it again, then try again.
Android 11 always shares the internet connection over Ethernet; local only is not possible.
Choose sharing the internet connection, or allow the fallback, and start again.
Something unexpected happened: %1$s
Copy the log and report it.
Android did not allow skipping the carrier check, so the request was sent with it.
Local only was refused, so tethering started with internet sharing, as you allowed.
You asked for local only, but Android reports that the internet connection is shared.
Android\'s tethering status cannot be read on this phone, so the result is not confirmed.
Stopping the previous tethering did not finish cleanly before the start.
Shizuku did not start the EtherTether engine in time.
Open Shizuku, stop and start it again, then try again.
Shizuku could not start the EtherTether engine.
Open Shizuku and check that it runs, then try again.
The EtherTether engine does not run as the shell user (%1$s).
Start Shizuku with wireless debugging, not with root.
The EtherTether engine is from another app version.
Close EtherTether completely and open it again.
The EtherTether engine stopped during the request.
Check that Shizuku runs, then try again.
The EtherTether engine did not answer.
Check the state shown here. If it is wrong, stop Shizuku, start it again and try once more.
On, sharing the internet connection, interface %1$s
On, local only, interface %1$s
Error on interface %1$s
Off. Adapter %1$s found.
Off. No Ethernet adapter found.
The adapter was removed, which ends Ethernet tethering. Plug it in again and tap Start.
up

connected
